title: Draft structured product vault architecture spec
description: Write docs/architecture/P18_STRUCTURED_ARCHITECTURE.md: principal-protected sleeve plus yield sleeve design, PT/YT tranche tokens, payoff calculator, cap-rate and principal-floor enforcement points. Acceptance: the doc states the exact on-chain checks enforcing the principal floor and cap rate, and maps catalog gates (principal_floor, cap_rate) to code locations.

title: Define vault, tranche, and payoff interfaces
description: Deliver IStructuredVault.sol (deposit, split, redeem), ITrancheToken.sol, and IPayoffCalculator.sol in onchain/src/p18-structured/interfaces/ plus Python types. Acceptance: interfaces compile under solc 0.8.24 and a mock payoff calculator implementing them prices the spec's example product exactly.

title: Specify 12 bps fee model to Treasury
description: Specify the 12 bps fee on deposits and on yield-sleeve harvests, routed to the SINCOR treasury at 0x09E2891432827D8835d2E9b83B25e2a5ba9612Ac, with worked examples for a principal-protected note. Acceptance: a reviewer can compute the treasury take for any deposit and harvest from the spec alone.

title: Create P18 repo layout and skeletons
description: Create onchain/src/p18-structured/{interfaces,tranches,vaults,StructuredVault.sol}, src/sincor2/defi/p18_structured/, tests/pytest/test_p18_structured.py, and agents/p18-structured-products.yaml as an empty-but-valid skeleton with a README module map. Acceptance: tree exists, YAML parses, no test collector errors from new paths.

title: Write vault and agent starter code
description: Write the StructuredVault skeleton with ReentrancyGuard, SafeERC20, non-bricking try/catch on the yield-source adapter, plus a Python agent skeleton with error handling and a TOA hook stub. Acceptance: compiles under solc 0.8.24 and the agent imports and answers a health ping.

title: Build PT and YT tranche tokens
description: Implement principal tokens (PT, redeemable for the protected principal at maturity) and yield tokens (YT, claim on the yield sleeve) as ERC-20s minted only by the vault on deposit split. Proven-agent work: split/mint accounting with exact conservation. Acceptance: compiles under solc 0.8.24; PT+YT always minted in exact proportion to the deposit with zero supply drift.

title: Build principal-protection sleeve
description: Implement the protection sleeve: deposits buy discounted zero-coupon-equivalent positions sized so PT redemption always meets the principal floor at maturity; floor enforced on-chain at redeem time. Proven-agent work: discount sizing math under rate moves. Acceptance: PT redemption can never return less than the principal floor in tests, including rate-shock scenarios.

title: Build yield sleeve with source adapter
description: Implement the yield sleeve: remaining capital routes into an allowlisted yield source (e.g., Morpho) via an adapter with non-bricking try/catch; harvests split between YT holders and the treasury fee. Acceptance: a yield-source failure never bricks PT redemption and harvest accounting matches events to the wei.

title: Build cap-rate payoff calculator
description: Implement the payoff calculator: participation rate and cap rate applied to the underlying's measured return at maturity, with fixed-point math and rounding that always favors the vault. Acceptance: calculator output matches the spec's worked payoff examples exactly, and payouts never exceed the cap rate.

title: Enforce cap rate on payouts
description: Enforce the cap rate on-chain: any computed payout above the cap is clamped, with the clamp emitted as an event; cap parameters updatable only via timelock. Acceptance: a test with an underlying return above the cap receives exactly the capped payout.

title: Build maturity and settlement
description: Implement maturity: permissionless settle() finalizes the underlying return measurement, PT redeems at protected principal plus capped upside, YT claims residual yield. Acceptance: full deposit-to-maturity lifecycle settles in tests with exact balance assertions.

title: Build access control and edge cases
description: Roles: product lister, yield-source allowlister, pauser; emergency early-maturity path; handle oracle staleness on the return measurement and reentrancy attempts. Acceptance: unauthorized actions revert, and a stale-oracle settlement attempt reverts rather than settling wrong.

title: Write P18 unit tests
description: Write tests/pytest/test_p18_structured.py covering tranche mint conservation, payoff calculator vs spec examples, and floor/cap enforcement. Acceptance: all unit tests green with the calculator matching worked examples exactly.

title: Write P18 integration tests
description: End-to-end: agent lists a product, user deposits, split mints PT/YT, yield accrues, maturity settles, treasury receives 12 bps. Acceptance: full lifecycle in CI with floor and fee assertions.

title: Write P18 invariant/fuzz tests
description: Fuzz invariants: PT redemption >= principal floor; payout <= cap rate; PT+YT supply conservation across splits/redeems. Acceptance: 10k fuzz runs, zero violations.

title: Run mainnet-fork structured product simulation
description: Simulate the full lifecycle on a mainnet fork with a real yield source across rate paths. Acceptance: principal floor holds on all paths and capped payouts never exceed the cap on 20+ simulated paths.

title: Assemble P18 audit-prep package
description: Audit package: flattened sources, full natspec, threat model (yield-source compromise, return-measurement manipulation, cap/floor parameter griefing). Acceptance: passes the repo audit-readiness checklist with zero missing artifacts.

title: Remediate P18 audit findings
description: Fix every audit finding with a regression test proving each fix. Acceptance: findings log 100% closed with linked tests, no new warnings.

title: Optimize P18 gas costs
description: Gas report for deposit/split/settle paths; pack tranche storage; batch settlement. Acceptance: documented gas report and settle under 300k gas on the reference fork.

title: Write P18 technical documentation
description: Technical docs: tranche mechanics, payoff formula with worked examples, yield-source onboarding guide, floor/cap accounting. Acceptance: a new builder can list a second structured product from the docs alone.

title: Write P18 agent YAML config and ops runbook
description: Deliver agents/p18-structured-products.yaml (budgets, memory, heartbeat, TOA hook) and docs/ops/P18_STRUCTURED_RUNBOOK.md covering yield-source failure and oracle outage. Acceptance: YAML validates against the repo agent schema; runbook covers the top 5 failure modes.

title: Build P18 dashboard and monitoring hooks
description: Monitoring hooks: TVL per product, PT coverage ratio vs floor, realized yield, treasury fee inflow to the SINCOR dashboard. Acceptance: hooks emit structured metrics and report unknown rather than healthy on stale data, per STATUS_FEED_SCHEMA.

title: Write P18 testnet deploy scripts
description: Write scripts/defi/p18/deploy_testnet.py deploying the vault, tranche token factory, and payoff calculator to Base Sepolia with a seeded principal-protected product. Acceptance: deployed, verified, and a deposit-to-maturity cycle executes on Sepolia.

title: Produce P18 mainnet readiness checklist
description: Mainnet readiness checklist: audit sign-off, floor/cap parameters ratified, yield-source allowlist finalized, timelock active, dry-run default confirmed, treasury address verified. Acceptance: every item signed off with evidence links before any mainnet deployment.
